description: A plain login request (no grant yet) and a granted request use the same page; nothing warns that approving before the granting agent runs `grant` creates a new empty drive. The CLI login output also does not tell the second agent to wait for a grant.
expected: Notice such as 'Expecting a drive from another agent? Wait for it before approving.'
actual: `New encrypted drive · full access` with an active Approve button
suggested_fix: Add a line to the pairing page and to login output about waiting for a grant.

description: Granted summary reads `priya-mbp agent · can read and write, writes only in /codex · offered by priya-mbp agent`: names the granter twice, omits the drive, and reads as if the granter receives access.
expected: `Read and write the drive 'research-notes', writes only in /codex, offered by priya-mbp agent`
actual: Granter name three times in four lines; drive shown only in Details as the agent's name
suggested_fix: Rewrite summary with the drive name and the recipient.

description: Granting with an unknown pairing code gives `Pass --verify with the verification code the new agent printed, exactly as shown...` even when the verification code is right. A mistyped verification code gives a tamper warning.
expected: Separate messages: 'No pending login with that code' vs typo help.
actual: Misleading text for unknown pairing code; alarming text for typo
suggested_fix: Distinguish unknown pairing code; soften typo wording while keeping the warning.

description: After grant and approval the second agent's `check` fails with `drive key not backed up` and the grant/approve pages never mention backing up credentials, so the story's last step cannot succeed as written.
expected: Approval success page or login output says to export credentials before `check`.
suggested_fix: Mention `credentials export` in the Logged in output for granted agents.

description: At 390px the verification input is narrow beside its label and the placeholder is clipped (`a1b2 c3d4 e5f6`).
expected: Label above input at phone width.
